The research position is funded under the AVENUE COVE European project. AVENUE brings together five European ecosystems to strengthen skills, education and training pathways, and career opportunities in the audiovisual and creative industries. The project focuses on vocational education and training (VET) and professional higher education in fields such as animation, video games, virtual production, visual storytelling, and Extended Reality (XR), while rethinking teaching and learning approaches within formal education systems. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Neighborhood Tourism and Cultural Heritagization: Participation and Social Innovation (Univ. PALERMO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-30 12:00
Institution: Univ. PALERMO, Palermo
Field: Political and social sciences / 14/GSPS-07 Sociologia della politica, del diritto e della devianza

The research program aims to address the cognitive demand for identifying strategies, processes, and products for the protection and enhancement of the environmental, social, economic, cultural, and tourism heritage of the Palermo area. Specifically, it focuses on "informal heritage"—heritage recognized as such by residents but connected to practices that do not comply with legal regulations.
